name: The Guiding March (導引)
about: Played as the emperor walks from the second gate to the temple, by two each of sheng, di, xiao, yunluo gong-chimes, tou-kuan double reeds, drums and castanets. Van Aalst gives it in gongche and on the staff ('somewhat as follows'); this follows his staff. Notes as pitch:beats, quarter notes as beats, / after a phrase.
